+    /// Background-only original Core mutation + publication, serialized with lazy binding.
+    pub(crate) fn commit_config(
+        &self,
+        path: &std::path::Path,
+        operation: impl FnOnce(&std::path::Path) -> anyhow::Result<nxtools_core::AppConfig>,
+    ) -> anyhow::Result<(nxtools_core::AppConfig, bool)> {
+        let _publication = self
+            .publication
+            .lock()
+            .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("extension publication unavailable"))?;
+        let config = operation(path)?;
+        let applied = self
+            .publish_locked(config.extensions.clone(), || {})
+            .is_ok();
+        Ok((config, applied))
+    }
